question: Should this PR establish message-level chat navigation for transcript hits, or should the linked feature be explicitly narrowed to opening only the containing session?
rationale: The current Chat route has no demonstrated public message deep-link contract, while the canonical issue explicitly requires direct navigation to the matching message; choosing or narrowing that product contract needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Add exact-message navigation
options.body: Define or reuse a bounded chat navigation target carrying `sessionKey` and `messageId`, and prove the matching message is focused after navigation.

options.title: Narrow to session navigation
options.body: Keep session-level opening only, but update the linked issue, PR wording, UI copy, and tests so no exact-message behavior is promised.

options.title: Split navigation follow-up
options.body: Land transcript discovery only after a maintainer explicitly accepts a canonical follow-up that owns the message deep-link contract.

recommendation.title: Add exact-message navigation
recommendation.body: Define or reuse a bounded chat navigation target carrying `sessionKey` and `messageId`, and prove the matching message is focused after navigation.

likelyOwner.reason: His merged history owns both the Sessions UI and the current Gateway transcript-search behavior, making him the strongest available decision owner for the cross-surface contract.
